intro: This unit is about Chinese history, especially the Tang dynasty. Grammar: (1) 其中 “among them” vs 在……中 “among / in”; (2) 在……看来 “in …'s view”; (3) 究竟 “exactly / on earth” in questions. Answers marked “model answer” were written for this sheet.

key_sentences.zh: 唐朝是中国最强盛的朝代之一。
key_sentences.py: Tángcháo shì Zhōngguó zuì qiángshèng de cháodài zhī yī.
key_sentences.en: The Tang was one of China's most powerful dynasties.

key_sentences.zh: 那时候出现了很多有名的诗人，其中我最喜欢的是李白。
key_sentences.py: Nà shíhou chūxiànle hěn duō yǒumíng de shīrén, qízhōng wǒ zuì xǐhuan de shì Lǐ Bái.
key_sentences.en: Many famous poets appeared then; my favourite among them is Li Bai.

key_sentences.zh: 在中国的四大发明中，火药和印刷术都是在唐朝发明的。
key_sentences.py: Zài Zhōngguó de sì dà fāmíng zhōng, huǒyào hé yìnshuāshù dōu shì zài Tángcháo fāmíng de.
key_sentences.en: Of China's Four Great Inventions, gunpowder and printing were both invented in the Tang.

key_sentences.zh: 在我看来，唐朝的最大特点是开放。
key_sentences.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, Tángcháo de zuì dà tèdiǎn shì kāifàng.
key_sentences.en: In my view, the Tang's greatest characteristic was its openness.

key_sentences.zh: 她究竟是什么样的人，大家的看法不完全一样。
key_sentences.py: Tā jiūjìng shì shénme yàng de rén, dàjiā de kànfǎ bù wánquán yíyàng.
key_sentences.en: People don't entirely agree on what kind of person she really was.

title.en: The difference between 其中 and 在……中

body.zh: “其中”表示指定内容中的一个部分。“在……中”引出指定范围。例如：
body.en: “其中” means “among them / of which” — part of something already mentioned. “在……中” sets up the range itself (“among …”), e.g.,

body.zh: （整体），其中 + 部分　·　在 + 整体 + 中，+ 部分
body.py: (zhěngtǐ), qízhōng + bùfen · zài + zhěngtǐ + zhōng, + bùfen
body.en: (the whole is mentioned first), among them + part · among + (the whole), + part

body.zh: 我们班有18个学生，其中男生10人，女生8人。
body.py: Wǒmen bān yǒu shíbā ge xuésheng, qízhōng nánshēng shí rén, nǚshēng bā rén.
body.en: Our class has 18 students, of whom 10 are boys and 8 are girls.

body.zh: 在我们班的18个学生中，男生有10人。
body.py: Zài wǒmen bān de shíbā ge xuésheng zhōng, nánshēng yǒu shí rén.
body.en: Among the 18 students in our class, 10 are boys.
其中 refers back, so the group must already have been mentioned: ✓ 唐代有很多著名的历史人物，其中…; ✗ 其中唐代的很多著名的历史人物… To introduce the group yourself, use 在……中: ✓ 在中国的四大发明中，…

body.zh: “在……看来”表示从某人的角度考虑会有怎样的看法。例如：
body.en: “在……看来” gives someone's opinion from their own point of view, e.g.,

body.zh: 在 + 某人 + 看来，+ 看法
在我看来，唐朝的最大特点是开放。
body.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, Tángcháo de zuì dà tèdiǎn shì kāifàng.
body.en: In my view, the Tang's greatest characteristic was openness.

body.zh: 在很多人看来，中国历史非常有意思。
body.py: Zài hěn duō rén kànlái, Zhōngguó lìshǐ fēicháng yǒu yìsi.
body.en: To many people, Chinese history is fascinating.
在 comes first and is needed: ✓ 在我看来 — ✗ 我在看来, ✗ 我看来.

body.zh: 副词“究竟”用在问句里，表示追究。例如：
body.en: The adverb “究竟” is used in questions to press for the real answer (“exactly / on earth”), e.g.,

body.zh: 主语 + 究竟 + 疑问（什么／谁／为什么／……还是……）
body.py: zhǔyǔ + jiūjìng + yíwèn (shénme / shéi / wèi shénme / …… háishi……)

body.zh: 你一会儿说想去，一会儿又说不想去，你究竟去还是不去？
body.py: Nǐ yíhuìr shuō xiǎng qù, yíhuìr yòu shuō bù xiǎng qù, nǐ jiūjìng qù háishi bú qù?
body.en: One minute you want to go, the next you don't — are you going or not?

body.py: Nǐ jiūjìng wèi shénme bù gāoxìng?
body.en: Why on earth are you unhappy?
究竟 goes before the question part, never at the end: ✓ 你报告的题目究竟是什么？ ✗ …是什么究竟？

instructions.zh: 分别用“其中”和“在……中”回答以下问题。
instructions.en: Answer each question twice: once with “其中” and once with “在……中”.

body.zh: 唐代有很多有名的诗人，其中我最喜欢的是李白。
body.py: Tángdài yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de shīrén, qízhōng wǒ zuì xǐhuan de shì Lǐ Bái.
body.en: The Tang had many famous poets; my favourite among them is Li Bai.

body.zh: 在唐代有名的诗人中，我最喜欢的是李白。
body.py: Zài Tángdài yǒumíng de shīrén zhōng, wǒ zuì xǐhuan de shì Lǐ Bái.
body.en: Of the Tang's famous poets, my favourite is Li Bai.

prompt.zh: 你知道中国的哪些朝代？你最感兴趣的是哪个朝代？
prompt.en: Which Chinese dynasties do you know? Which interests you most?

answer.zh: 我知道唐朝、宋朝、明朝和清朝，其中我最感兴趣的是唐朝。
answer.py: Wǒ zhīdào Tángcháo, Sòngcháo, Míngcháo hé Qīngcháo, qízhōng wǒ zuì gǎn xìngqù de shì Tángcháo.
answer.en: I know the Tang, Song, Ming and Qing; of these, the Tang interests me most. (model answer)

answer.zh: 在我知道的朝代中，我最感兴趣的是唐朝。
answer.py: Zài wǒ zhīdào de cháodài zhōng, wǒ zuì gǎn xìngqù de shì Tángcháo.
answer.en: Of the dynasties I know, the Tang interests me most. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 学习语言时，你认为听、说、读、写四个方面哪些方面很重要？最难的是哪个方面？
prompt.en: Of listening, speaking, reading and writing, which matter most? Which is hardest?

answer.zh: 听、说、读、写都很重要，其中最难的是写。
answer.py: Tīng, shuō, dú, xiě dōu hěn zhòngyào, qízhōng zuì nán de shì xiě.
answer.en: All four matter; of them, writing is the hardest. (model answer)

answer.zh: 在听、说、读、写四个方面中，我觉得最难的是写。
answer.py: Zài tīng, shuō, dú, xiě sì ge fāngmiàn zhōng, wǒ juéde zuì nán de shì xiě.
answer.en: Of the four skills, I find writing the hardest. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 你们班有多少学生？多少男生？多少女生？
prompt.en: How many students are in your class? How many boys and girls?

answer.zh: 我们班有15个学生，其中男生7个，女生8个。
answer.py: Wǒmen bān yǒu shíwǔ ge xuésheng, qízhōng nánshēng qī ge, nǚshēng bā ge.
answer.en: Our class has 15 students: 7 boys and 8 girls. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 你都有哪些课？哪门课最难？
prompt.en: What classes do you have? Which is hardest?

answer.zh: 在我的课中，最难的是汉字课。
answer.py: Zài wǒ de kè zhōng, zuì nán de shì Hànzì kè.
answer.en: Of my classes, the character class is the hardest. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 用“在……看来”就以下问题发表各自的见解，并向全班汇报。
instructions.en: Give your views on these questions using “在……看来”, then report to the class.

body.zh: 在我看来，唐朝的最大特点是开放。
body.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, Tángcháo de zuì dà tèdiǎn shì kāifàng.
body.en: In my view, the Tang's greatest characteristic was openness.

prompt.zh: 人生中最值得庆祝的是什么事？
prompt.en: What's most worth celebrating in life?

answer.zh: 在我看来，人生中最值得庆祝的是找到了相爱的人。
answer.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, rénshēng zhōng zuì zhídé qìngzhù de shì zhǎodàole xiāng'ài de rén.
answer.en: In my view, finding someone you love is the most worth celebrating. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 环保更重要还是发展生产更重要？
prompt.en: Which matters more, environmental protection or developing production?

answer.zh: 在我看来，环保比发展生产更重要。
answer.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, huánbǎo bǐ fāzhǎn shēngchǎn gèng zhòngyào.
answer.en: In my view, protecting the environment matters more. (model answer)

prompt.zh: 在大城市生活好还是在小城市生活好？
prompt.en: Is it better to live in a big city or a small one?

answer.zh: 在我看来，在小城市生活更舒服。
answer.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, zài xiǎo chéngshì shēnghuó gèng shūfu.
answer.en: In my view, life in a small city is more comfortable. (model answer)

prompt.py: Jiāo péngyou shí, shénme zuì zhòngyào?
prompt.en: What matters most when making friends?

answer.zh: 在我看来，交朋友时最重要的是真心。
answer.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, jiāo péngyou shí zuì zhòngyào de shì zhēnxīn.
answer.en: In my view, sincerity matters most. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 一个人根据图片和提示词用“究竟”提问，另一个人用“究竟”回答。
instructions.en: One person asks a question with “究竟” based on the picture and cue words; the other answers with “究竟”.

body.en: Example: a portrait of Empress Wu Zetian. Cue: 什么样的人 shénme yàng de rén.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 武则天究竟是什么样的人？
lines.py: Wǔ Zétiān jiūjìng shì shénme yàng de rén?
lines.en: What kind of person was Wu Zetian really?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我不知道她究竟是什么样的人。
lines.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā jiūjìng shì shénme yàng de rén.
lines.en: I don't know what kind of person she really was.

items.picture: A portrait of the poet Li Bai. Cues: 李白，诗歌，一共多少.

answer.zh: A：李白究竟一共写了多少首诗歌？B：我不知道他究竟一共写了多少首。
answer.py: A: Lǐ Bái jiūjìng yígòng xiěle duōshao shǒu shīgē? B: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā jiūjìng yígòng xiěle duōshao shǒu.
answer.en: A: How many poems did Li Bai actually write in all? B: I don't know exactly how many. (model answer)

items.picture: A painting of a court lady in old Chinese dress. Cues: 画，朝代.

answer.zh: A：这幅画究竟是哪个朝代的？B：我不知道这幅画究竟是哪个朝代的。
answer.py: A: Zhè fú huà jiūjìng shì nǎge cháodài de? B: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhè fú huà jiūjìng shì nǎge cháodài de.
answer.en: A: Which dynasty is this painting from, exactly? B: I don't know which dynasty it's from. (model answer)

items.picture: An athlete raising both arms in victory with a medal. Cues: 谁，获得.

answer.zh: A：究竟是谁获得了冠军？B：我也不知道究竟是谁获得了冠军。
answer.py: A: Jiūjìng shì shéi huòdéle guànjūn? B: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào jiūjìng shì shéi huòdéle guànjūn.
answer.en: A: Who on earth won the championship? B: I don't know who won either. (model answer)

items.picture: A porcelain table lamp. Cue: 毛病.

answer.zh: A：这个台灯究竟有什么毛病？B：我不知道它究竟有什么毛病。
answer.en: A: What exactly is wrong with this lamp? B: I don't know what's wrong with it. (model answer)

answer.zh: A：火药究竟是谁发明的？B：我不知道火药究竟是谁发明的。
answer.py: A: Huǒyào jiūjìng shì shéi fāmíng de? B: Wǒ bù zhīdào huǒyào jiūjìng shì shéi fāmíng de.
answer.en: A: Who exactly invented gunpowder? B: I don't know who invented it. (model answer)

answer.zh: A：唐朝究竟为什么那么强盛？B：我不知道唐朝究竟为什么那么强盛。
answer.py: A: Tángcháo jiūjìng wèi shénme nàme qiángshèng? B: Wǒ bù zhīdào Tángcháo jiūjìng wèi shénme nàme qiángshèng.
answer.en: A: Why exactly was the Tang so powerful? B: I don't know why exactly. (model answer)

prompt.py: dì-yī ge cháodài, jiànlì, nǎ nián

answer.zh: A：中国的第一个朝代究竟是哪年建立的？B：我不知道它究竟是哪年建立的。
answer.py: A: Zhōngguó de dì-yī ge cháodài jiūjìng shì nǎ nián jiànlì de? B: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā jiūjìng shì nǎ nián jiànlì de.
answer.en: A: In which year exactly was China's first dynasty founded? B: I don't know which year. (model answer)

answer.zh: A：唐装究竟有什么特点？B：我不知道唐装究竟有什么特点。
answer.py: A: Tángzhuāng jiūjìng yǒu shénme tèdiǎn? B: Wǒ bù zhīdào tángzhuāng jiūjìng yǒu shénme tèdiǎn.
answer.en: A: What exactly is special about Tang-style clothing? B: I don't know what's special about it. (model answer)

instructions.zh: 在正确的句子或合适的答句前打✓，看看你语法学得怎么样。
instructions.en: Tick ✓ the right sentence or answer to check how well you have learned the grammar.

options.zh: 唐代有很多著名的历史人物，其中我认为最有意思的是武则天。
options.py: Tángdài yǒu hěn duō zhùmíng de lìshǐ rénwù, qízhōng wǒ rènwéi zuì yǒu yìsi de shì Wǔ Zétiān.

options.zh: 其中唐代的很多著名的历史人物，我认为最有意思的是武则天。
options.py: Qízhōng Tángdài de hěn duō zhùmíng de lìshǐ rénwù, wǒ rènwéi zuì yǒu yìsi de shì Wǔ Zétiān.

questions.explain: 其中 refers back to a group already mentioned. (grammar note 1)

question.zh: 你认为发展经济更重要还是保护环境更重要？
question.py: Nǐ rènwéi fāzhǎn jīngjì gèng zhòngyào háishi bǎohù huánjìng gèng zhòngyào?
question.en: Do you think economic development or environmental protection is more important?

options.zh: 在我看来，保护环境比发展经济更重要。
options.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, bǎohù huánjìng bǐ fāzhǎn jīngjì gèng zhòngyào.

options.zh: 我在看来，保护环境比发展经济更重要。
options.py: Wǒ zài kànlái, bǎohù huánjìng bǐ fāzhǎn jīngjì gèng zhòngyào.

questions.explain: The order is 在 + person + 看来. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 在中国的四大发明中，有两个是在唐朝发明的。
options.py: Zài Zhōngguó de sì dà fāmíng zhōng, yǒu liǎng ge shì zài Tángcháo fāmíng de.

options.zh: 其中中国的四大发明，有两个是在唐朝发明的。
options.py: Qízhōng Zhōngguó de sì dà fāmíng, yǒu liǎng ge shì zài Tángcháo fāmíng de.

questions.explain: To introduce the group yourself, use 在……中. (grammar note 1)

options.zh: 在我看来，李白是最有名的诗人之一。
options.py: Zài wǒ kànlái, Lǐ Bái shì zuì yǒumíng de shīrén zhī yī.

options.zh: 我看来，李白是最有名的诗人之一。
options.py: Wǒ kànlái, Lǐ Bái shì zuì yǒumíng de shīrén zhī yī.

questions.explain: 在 is required: 在我看来. (grammar note 2)

options.zh: 你报告的题目究竟是什么？
options.py: Nǐ bàogào de tímù jiūjìng shì shénme?

options.zh: 你报告的题目是什么究竟？
options.py: Nǐ bàogào de tímù shì shénme jiūjìng?

questions.explain: 究竟 goes before the question part. (grammar note 3)

quiz.answer_note: Book's scoring: all right — 太棒了！. Missed Q5 — review 究竟 (note 3). Missed Q1 or Q3 — review 其中 vs 在……中 (note 1). Missed Q2 or Q4 — review 在……看来 (note 2).
